references.text: Joseph's brothers were jealous of him, which can be compared to the feeling of envy that the leading priests had for Jesus.
David's description of wicked people standing against the Lord and His anointed, driven by anger and conspiracy, may reflect the feelings and actions of those who handed over Jesus.
Daniel experiences jealousy from his colleagues, who conspire against him because of his success, paralleling how Jesus was handed over out of envy.
